summary: This document updates RFC 5880 by defining a small set of interval values that Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD) implementations should support. Some implementations can only use a few timer values, so two peers might fail to find an interval both can run. Having a common set makes sure they can always agree.

eli5.summary: Two friends want to check on each other every few seconds, but each can only use certain timers. This note says everyone should know a few common timers, so any two friends can always pick one that works.

questions: how do bfd peers agree on an interval
